run NegativeScenario1 {
    some disj u1, u2 : User |
    some disj a : Photo |
    some disj d : Day {
        User = u1 + u2
        Influencer = none
        Photo = a
        Ad = a
        Day = d
        User <: follows = none->none
        User <: sees = u1->a
        User <: posts = u1->a
        User <: suggested = none->none
        Photo <: date = a->d
    }
} for exactly 2 User, exactly 1 Photo, exactly 1 Day expect 0

run PositiveScenario3 {
    some disj w : Workstation |
    some disj r : Worker |
    some disj c1, c2 : Product {
        Workstation = w
        begin = w
        end = w
        Workstation <: workers = w->r
        Workstation <: succ = none->none
        Worker = r
        Human = none
        Robot = r
        Product = c1 + c2
        Material = none
        Component = c1 + c2
        Dangerous = none
        Product <: parts = c1->c2 + c2->c1
        Component <: workstation = c1->w + c2->w
    }
} for exactly 1 Workstation, exactly 1 Worker, exactly 2 Product expect 1

run NegativeScenario1 {
    some disj p1, p2 : Person |
    some c : Course |
    some g : Grade {
        Person = p1 + p2
        Professor = p1 + p2
        Student = p2
        Course = c
        Project = none
        Grade = g
        Person <: teaches = p1->c
        Person <: enrolled = p2->c
        Person <: projects = none->none
        Course <: projects = none->none
        Course <: grades = none->none->none
        Grade <: next = none->none
    }
} for exactly 2 Person, exactly 1 Course, exactly 0 Project, exactly 1 Grade expect 0

run NegativeScenario2 {
    some disj p1, p2, s : Person |
    some disj c1, c2 : Course |
    some disj j1, j2 : Project |
    some g : Grade {
        Person = p1 + p2 + s
        Professor = p1 + p2
        Student = p2 + s
        Course = c1 + c2
        Project = j1 + j2
        Grade = g
        Person <: teaches = p1->c1 + p2->c2
        Person <: enrolled = p2->c1 + s->c2
        Person <: projects = p2->j1 + s->j2
        Course <: projects = c1->j1 + c2->j2
        Course <: grades = c1->p2->g + c2->s->g
        Grade <: next = none->none
    }
} for exactly 3 Person, exactly 2 Course, exactly 2 Project, exactly 1 Grade expect 0
